.claude-plugin/marketplace.json.summary: Plugin marketplace manifest for better-base-tools v1.2.0. Declares two plugins: batch_file_tools and project-intel-tool. Provides metadata for plugin discovery and installation.

.gitignore.summary: Specifies patterns for files and directories to exclude from version control. Ignores build artifacts (.claude/, Claude_Temp_Files/, node_modules/, dist/), logs, OS files (.DS_Store), coverage reports, and vitest cache.

plugins/batch_file_tools/.claude-plugin/.summary: Plugin manifest for batch_file_tools v1.2.1. Provides metadata: name, description (batch file I/O reducing tool calls by 50–60%), author, repository links, and keywords for discoverability.

plugins/batch_file_tools/.mcp.json.summary: MCP server configuration for batch_file_tools plugin. Specifies Node.js command to run the compiled server at plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/dist/index.js.

plugins/batch_file_tools/CHANGELOG.md.summary: Detailed changelog for batch_file_tools v0.1.0–v1.2.1 (2026-04-22 to 2026-06-01). Covers fixes, enhancements, and design improvements to batch read/edit operations, output formatting, path handling, and error reporting.

plugins/batch_file_tools/CLAUDE.md.summary: Project instructions for batch_file_tools. Advises using batch_read/batch_edit over built-in tools and bundling related operations into single calls to reduce round-trips and context overhead.

plugins/batch_file_tools/hooks/hooks.jso.summary: Hook configuration for batch_file_tools SessionStart event. Executes session-start.js on plugin load to validate build artifacts and initialize context.

plugins/batch_file_tools/hooks/session-s.summary: Node.js hook script run at SessionStart. Validates MCP server build exists, reads CLAUDE.md for context injection, and responds with status. Helps detect misconfigured or incomplete plugin installations.

plugins/batch_file_tools/LICENSE.summary: MIT License for batch_file_tools (2026) by Thore Höltig. Standard open-source license allowing use, modification, and distribution with attribution.

plugins/batch_file_tools/README.md.summary: Documentation for batch_file_tools MCP plugin that provides efficient multi-file reading and editing. Explains why batching reduces context overhead by 45-91%, details batch_read (compact/verbatim/fileinfo modes with search/glob support) and batch_edit tools (replace/insert/delete operations), configuration options (formatting normalization, dry-run mode), and performance metrics from real projects.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/package.summary: NPM lockfile pinning exact versions of all dependencies and transitive dependencies for batch-tools-mcp-server. Contains 200+ packages including @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.29.0, zod 3.25.76, and dev dependencies for TypeScript, vitest, tsx, and build tools. Ensures reproducible builds and consistent dependency resolution across environments.

Project manifest for batch-tools-mcp-server v1.2.1, an MCP server supporting batch file read/edit operations. Defines build/test scripts, bin entrypoint, dependencies (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk, zod), and dev tools (TypeScript, vitest). Requires Node >=22 and targets distribution via npm.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/src/ind.summary: Main MCP server entrypoint implementing batch_read and batch_edit tools for file operations. Handles CLI args, permission management, progress reporting, and path elicitation. Registers two tools with input validation (Zod), output formatting, and comprehensive error handling. Supports dry-run, dry-run, structured content, and custom logging modes.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/src/lib.summary: Manages in-memory file buffers for edit operations. Handles loading file content while preserving line endings (CRLF vs LF), tracking file existence state, and writing modified buffers back to disk. Provides BufferLoadError for detailed error reporting during file I/O.

Core edit operation logic implementing replace, replace_all, insert_at_line, replace_range, and write operations on file buffers. Handles exact and fuzzy whitespace-normalized matching, overlap detection for line-addressed ops, newline conversion, and detailed error reporting with nearest-anchor hints.

Formats tool output for different audiences (user vs assistant). Converts read and edit results into annotated ToolContentResult objects with priority and audience metadata. Generates human-readable summaries of operations and highlights errors/partial successes.

Extracts file references from source code using regex patterns for ES/TS imports, CommonJS requires, Markdown links, and file path literals. Filters out HTTP/HTTPS URLs and returns deduplicated list of relative/absolute file paths.

Low-level filesystem operations with authorization checks. Handles path resolution, realpath symlink resolution, file reading, guard path validation against allowed directories. Provides comprehensive error mapping for ENOENT, EISDIR, EACCES, EPERM with detailed Reason enums.

Glob pattern expansion and directory traversal. Detects whether a path is a glob pattern or directory, expands globs to sorted real (symlink-resolved) file paths, filters out directories. Handles dangling symlinks gracefully.

Byte-exact line splitting and joining preserving CRLF vs LF distinction. Tracks line endings separately from content to enable round-trip preservation. Provides normalized matching for cross-line-ending searches and newline conversion utilities.

Levenshtein distance algorithm for fuzzy string matching and finding nearest lines in files. Builds verbatim anchor windows around similar lines for error hints. Used in Phase 4 to help users fix edit failures with suggestions.

Output formatting for different read modes (compact vs verbatim). Compact mode collapses non-indent-sensitive files to single line, minifies JSON, collapses whitespace. Indent-sensitive files (Python, YAML, Makefile) preserve structure. Normalizes indentation for display.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/src/too.summary: Main edit operation handler orchestrating batch file edits. Manages glob expansion, operation sequencing (line-addressed first, reverse order to avoid offset drift), phase-1 overlap detection, dry-run mode, and file I/O with progress callbacks. Generates detailed error results.

Main read operation handler supporting glob expansion, search with context lines, range reads, and fileinfo mode with dependency extraction. Deduplicates redundant requests, maintains file cache, supports search term matching with multi-line context blocks.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/src/typ.summary: Zod schema definitions for the batch file tools API. Defines types for read operations (ReadMode, ReadRequest, ReadOutput), write operations (EditOp, EditFile, EditInput, EditOutput), error handling (FileError, Reason), and tool output formatting. Covers all request/response contracts and validation schemas for the plugin.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/a.summary: Test suite verifying authorization controls for read and edit operations. Tests that unauthorized directory access is rejected, that missing allowedDirectories blocks all access, and that nested path creation respects boundaries. Uses temporary directories for isolation.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/e.summary: Test suite for edit operation control flow: stopOnError at file/op/root levels, dryRun mode preventing disk writes, output filtering (non-ok ops only), and stopOnError resolution hierarchy. Tests abort semantics and cross-file behavior.

Test suite for fuzzy whitespace-normalized matching in replace/replace_all operations. Verifies that indentation differences (tabs vs spaces, 2-space vs 4-space) don't prevent successful replacements, and that exact matches take precedence over fuzzy.

Comprehensive vitest suite testing batch file edit operations including write, insert_at_line, replace_range, replace, and replace_all ops. Validates file creation, CRLF preservation, line-ending auto-match, phased execution order, error handling with overlap detection, and multi-file batching across 548 lines.

Vitest test suite validating formatReadContent and formatEditContent envelope formatting functions. Tests output formatting for single/multiple files, verbatim/compact modes, search match blocks, context merging, error reporting, operation status summaries, and nearest anchor hints across 341 lines.

Vitest test suite for extractRefs utility that identifies file references from code (ES imports, require, dynamic imports, markdown links) and extracts Windows paths. Tests relative path extraction, npm/node builtin filtering, deduplication, sorting, and multiformat reference detection across 103 lines.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/g.summary: Vitest test suite for glob expansion in batch editing across multiple files. Validates glob patterns matching, directory traversal, incompatible operation rejection, authorization checks, path normalization, operation merging, and deduplication. Tests single-level and recursive directory matching across 248 lines.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/l.summary: Vitest test suite validating line splitting and joining utilities with focus on line-ending preservation. Tests splitLines and joinLines round-trip integrity with LF/CRLF mixed endings, trailing newline handling, and line counting across 69 lines.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/r.summary: Comprehensive vitest suite testing batch file read operations with verbatim/compact modes, partial reads, line search with context, glob expansion, fileinfo metadata, and deduplication logic. Validates content preservation, search merge strategies, mode coalescing, and symlink deduplication across 514 lines.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/s.summary: Vitest test suite for similarity matching utilities including levenshtein distance, line finding with fuzzy matching, and nearest anchor building. Tests typo tolerance, similarity thresholds, anchor windowing with uniqueness validation, and edge cases across 125 lines.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/t.summary: Vitest test suite for content transformation functions in compact and verbatim read modes. Tests whitespace normalization, indent handling for Python/YAML/Makefiles, JSON minification, CRLF preservation, line-ending auto-conversion, and indent normalization across 266 lines.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tsconfi.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration targeting ES2022 with strict mode enabled. Outputs to dist/, sources in src/, enforces type safety with noImplicitAny, noUnusedLocals, exactOptionalPropertyTypes. Includes sourcemaps and declarations for library distribution. Strict checks prevent unsafe patterns.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/vitest..summary: Vitest test runner configuration defining test glob pattern (tests/**/*.test.ts), Node.js environment for running unit tests, and using defineConfig for type-safe setup. Minimal config focused on test discovery and Node environment execution.

plugins/project-intel-tool/.claude-plugi.summary: Plugin metadata manifest defining project-intel-tool as lightweight reconnaissance system v1.3.0. Includes name, description, author info, repository links, license, and keywords emphasizing token efficiency and context optimization without external dependencies.

plugins/project-intel-tool/.mcp.json.summary: MCP server configuration for project-intel-tool plugin specifying Node.js command and distribution script path entry point. Single-file configuration for Model Context Protocol integration.

plugins/project-intel-tool/CHANGELOG.md.summary: Detailed changelog documenting project-intel-tool evolution from v0.1.0 to v1.3.0 (2026-05-27 to 2026-06-02). Highlights include MCP server port, semantic analysis, role filtering, searchTags field, query output cleanup, ref extraction improvements, and reliability fixes across 191 lines.

plugins/project-intel-tool/hooks/hooks.j.summary: Hook configuration registering SessionStart event handler that invokes the compiled sessionstart-knowledge-check.js script. Single hook definition for project-intel-tool session lifecycle integration.

plugins/project-intel-tool/hooks/session.summary: Node.js entry point script for SessionStart hook that validates plugin installation and build status. Spawns compiled sessionstart-knowledge-check.js with environment and working directory context, providing actionable error messages if build is missing across 44 lines.

plugins/project-intel-tool/LICENSE.summary: MIT License document for project-intel-tool authored by Thore Höltig (c) 2026. Standard open-source license granting permissions for use, modification, and distribution with liability limitations.

plugins/project-intel-tool/README.md.summary: Documentation for project-intel-tool MCP server maintaining persistent project structure and semantic knowledge. Covers two-layer data model (structural data always up-to-date, semantic data from AI scans), query tool for keyword-based file searches with semantic scoring, scan tool for batch AI analysis with topological dependency ordering, session start hooks, and configuration options. Enables models to navigate projects efficiently without reading full files.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/index.summary: MCP server (v1.3.0) providing project intelligence tools: scan (analyze files with AI), query (search summaries), submit_analysis (batch result ingestion). Handles file discovery, sampling batch preparation, knowledge directory management, lock-based concurrency, and dual modes (MCP-native sampling vs subagent orchestration). Supports environment config, logging, and root directory updates.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/f.summary: Vitest unit tests for parseFileRefs() function covering TS/JS/C#/markdown file reference parsing. Tests resolve relative imports (.ts extension, index.ts fallback), parent directory imports, external package extraction, scoped packages, named/re-exports, require()/import(), dynamic imports, deduplication, and text file path mentions. Validates sizeChars/lineCount calculation.

Parses source files (TS/JS/C#/text) to extract imports, exports, and intra-project file references. Uses regex patterns to resolve relative imports, extract named exports, and identify file path mentions. Handles extension resolution and cross-file dependency detection across multiple languages.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/p.summary: Scans project directories to detect new, modified, and deleted files. Integrates with git for change detection and builds file metadata (size, line count, imports/exports). Discovers sub-projects with knowledge directories. Generates ScanResult with project statistics and files ready for analysis.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/s.summary: Unit tests for buildSamplingBatches using vitest. Tests dependency ordering (ensures dependencies processed before dependents), token budget management, batch splitting, circular dependency handling, and context file inclusion. Validates that files appear in exactly one batch.

Builds dependency-aware sampling batches for file analysis using topological sorting. Estimates token consumption per file and respects token budgets. Constructs prompts from file content, runs sampling via MCP server, parses JSON responses, and writes batch files. Handles indent-sensitive languages specially.

Vitest unit tests for summary-merger functions. Tests normalization of file paths (handles ./ prefix and backslashes), collision resolution for duplicate keys, round-trip serialization, file deletion marking, and sampling result merging. Validates JSON storage format stability.

Manages file summary persistence in JSON format. Handles reading/writing summaries with path normalization (converts abs paths to relative, backslashes to forward slashes). Merges sampling results, marks files deleted, resolves key collisions keeping non-deleted/recent entries. Ensures stable sorted output for git diffs.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/packa.summary: NPM lock file (v3) pinning dependencies for project-intel-mcp-server v1.6.1.0. Contains production deps (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.29.0, zod@3.25.76) and 50+ dev dependencies including TypeScript, Vitest, Vite, and Rolldown. Node >=22 required. Used for reproducible builds and dependency management across platforms.

NPM package manifest for project-intel-mcp-server (v1.3.0), a lightweight reconnaissance system providing project knowledge before exploration. Exports MCP server tool for querying relevant files. Dev scripts: build (tsc), test (vitest run), inspect (MCP inspector). Main deps: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.29.0, zod@3.25.76. Node >=22.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/sessi.summary: Hook script for SessionStart event that checks project knowledge status and suggests scanning. Scans project root for existing .knowledge directory, reports file summaries count, changed/unanalyzed files. Outputs HookResponse JSON recommending users use query MCP tool for token-efficient project exploration. Guides users through knowledge generation workflow.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/tscon.summary: TypeScript compiler config targeting ES2022 with strict settings. Compiles lib/, index.ts, sessionstart-knowledge-check.ts to dist/. Enables declaration files, sourceMap, strict type checking, no-unused-locals/parameters, no-implicit-returns, exact optional properties. Excludes node_modules and dist from input.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/types.summary: Type definitions and constants for project-intel MCP server. Exports FileRole enum, configuration types (ScanConfig, SamplingBatch), data structures (FileSummary, SummariesData), query output types (HierarchicalGrouping, ScoredFileSummary), hook response interface, and Zod-validated ToolContentResult schema. Defines directory/file names and sampling parameters.

README.md.summary: Project overview for better-base-tools, a Claude Code plugin collection that optimizes file operations and project knowledge management. Describes two main plugins: batch_file_tools for efficient multi-file reading/editing with glob support, and project-intel-tool for persistent semantic project knowledge with incremental git-based scanning.
